label: Every actual root apprehends some content through a good-general favouring
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every actual concrete root r at w has, for some favouring profile phi, the real determination that its own favouring is phi with phi good-general, and r itself apprehends some content that is about some candidate. The conjunction does not say that the apprehension governs the favouring (BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_3).
